kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Apabhramsa 𑆑𑆩𑆬 (kamala), from Sanskrit कमल (kamala). For the consonants underlying the conservative Apabhramsa spelling compare later Sindhi ڪَنَولُ /कंवलु (kanaulu), Punjabi ਕੰਵਲ /کَن٘وَل (kãval), Old Marathi 𑘎𑘪𑘯 (kavaḷa), Old Hindi कवल (kavala), Hindustani کَن٘وَل (kãval) / कँवल (kãval). Or more directly from Sanskrit काम्पिल्ल (kāmpilla), काम्पिल्य (kāmpilya, “Mallotus philippensis”). Ultimately a Dravidian borrowing.
g: kamala (Mallotus philippensis and by modern extension Mallotus gen. et spp.)
